data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to detect headset plug/unplug and Bluetooth connection events.
data.what_it_does: Provides APIs to get the current headset state and listen for changes when a headset is plugged or unplugged. Supports both physical and Bluetooth headsets on Android and iOS.
use_when: You need to react to headset plug/unplug events in your app
You need to know whether a Bluetooth headset is connected
avoid_when: You only need basic audio playback without headset awareness
You prefer a stream‑based API instead of callbacks
strengths: Supports physical and Bluetooth headsets on both platforms
weaknesses: Requires manual AndroidManifest changes and permission handling
data.setup_notes: Update compileSdkVersion to 33, add a receiver and exported activity in AndroidManifest, request BLUETOOTH_CONNECT permission (e.g., via permission_handler).
